from pathlib import Path
import ast
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if len(colors) == 1:
        color = next(iter(colors))
        return [[color for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    diagonals = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                d = c - r
                if d in diagonals and diagonals[d] != value:
                    raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal")
                diagonals[d] = value
    period = len(diagonals)
    profile = {d % period: value for d, value in diagonals.items()}
    return [[profile[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
